events.name: Bash
events.head: Check repo collaborators, pending invites and the H034 audit entry
events.input: $ [redacted]; echo "--- collaborators"; gh api repos/$R/collaborators --jq '.[] | "\(.login) \(.role_name)"'; echo "--- invitations"; gh api repos/$R/invitations --jq '.[] | "\(.id) \(.invitee.login) \(.permissions) created=\(.created_at) expired=\(.expired)"'; echo "--- H034"; grep -n "H034" [redacted].md | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Update T-146, ack the note, confirm the saved state
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py set T-146 status=review needs_from_owner="" note="Removed the question about Amal, Ben and Bharath: scope is Nelbin, Bhaskar and Aquila only. Checked the GitHub API on 2026-10-09: Nelbin (nelbinxav) has write access; the invites for Bhaskar (starmangrowth, 336830663) and Aquila (aquila-growthclub, 336830667) are still pending and not expired, so nothing was resent. H034 stays open in AUDIT.md until both accept; nothing is needed from Adi." && python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py ack F-8c9a559a && python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Commit the task board changes
events.input: $ git add -- workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json workshop-plan/tasks/inbox.jsonl && git commit -q -m "Agent T-146: dropped the Amal/Ben/Bharath question, invites for Bhaskar and Aquila still pending, task stays in review, note acked

events.text: T-146 stays in review: the question for Adi is removed, but the invites for Bhaskar and Aquila are still pending (not expired, so not resent) and H034 stays open in AUDIT.md until both accept; F-8c9a559a is acked and the change is committed as 024af70.
